Syftet med studien är att belysa möjliga samarbetsformer med civila samhället inom ramen för den relativt nya resultatstrategin för Uganda. Studien kommer att ge´värdefull vägledning och beslutsunderlag i opertionaliseringsprocessen av strategin och utformningen av portföljen.

The purpose of the study is to provide evidence and recommendations for the Embassy to support CSOs in a holistic and focused manner that would enable the results of CSOs to underpin and strongly contribute to the results areas of the strategy for development cooperation with Uganda. The study will define the specific added value and role of CSOs currently supported and propose coherent, transparent and precise selection criteria for strategic and long-term support to CSOs and priorities in terms of areas and modalities of collaboration. The recommendations and suggestions of the study will inform the design of the Swedish-Ugandan Development Cooperation 2014-2018.
